---
title: "Bulk RNAseq Analysis Report"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
    code_folding: hide
    fig_width: 8
    fig_height: 5
params:
  counts_file:   "counts.csv"
  meta_file:     "metadata.csv"
  filter_by_type: true
  gene_types:    !r c("protein_coding", "lincRNA")
  min_cpm:       0.5
  min_samples:   2
  group_col:     "Group"
  group_a:       "Treatment"
  group_b:       "Control"
  fdr:           0.05
  lfc:           1
  pca_color_by:  "Group"
  pca_shape_by:  null
  hm_ann_cols:   !r c("Group")
  hm_n_genes:    50
  genes_of_interest: !r c()
  bp_x_by:       "Group"
  bp_facet_by:   null
  bp_color_by:   "Group"
  run_gsea:      false
  gmt_file:      null
  gsea_pval:     0.05
  run_ora:       false
  ora_species:   "mouse"
  ora_ont:       "BP"
  species:       "mouse"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center")
source("R/functions.R")
p <- params
```

---

## 1. Data Loading & Filtering

```{r load}
dge <- load_and_filter(
  p$counts_file, p$meta_file,
  gene_types     = p$gene_types,
  filter_by_type = p$filter_by_type,
  min_cpm        = p$min_cpm,
  min_samples    = p$min_samples
)
log2cpm <- make_log2cpm(dge)
meta    <- dge$samples
```

```{r load-summary}
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Metric = c("Genes retained", "Samples", "CPM filter", "Min samples", "Normalisation"),
  Value  = c(nrow(dge), ncol(dge), p$min_cpm, p$min_samples, "TMM")
), caption = "Filtering summary")
```

**Metadata:**
```{r meta-table}
knitr::kable(meta)
```

---

## 2. Quality Control

### Library Size

```{r qc-libsize, fig.height=4}
plot_library_size(dge, color_by = p$group_col)
```

### Expression Density

```{r qc-density, fig.height=4}
plot_density(dge, color_by = p$group_col)
```

---

## 3. PCA

```{r pca, fig.height=5}
plot_pca(log2cpm, meta,
         color_by = p$pca_color_by,
         shape_by = p$pca_shape_by,
         n_genes  = 2500)
```

---

## 4. Differential Expression: `r p$group_a` vs `r p$group_b`

```{r de}
de <- run_DE(dge, p$group_col, p$group_a, p$group_b,
             fdr = p$fdr, lfc = p$lfc)
```

**Summary:** `r nrow(de$up)` up-regulated, `r nrow(de$down)` down-regulated
(FDR < `r p$fdr`, |log2FC| > `r p$lfc`).

### Volcano Plot

```{r volcano, fig.height=5}
plot_volcano(de, fdr = p$fdr, lfc = p$lfc)
```

### MA Plot

```{r ma, fig.height=5}
plot_ma(de, fdr = p$fdr, lfc = p$lfc)
```

### Top DE Genes

```{r de-table}
top_tab <- head(de$all[order(de$all$FDR), ], 30)
knitr::kable(top_tab[, setdiff(colnames(top_tab), "genes")],
             digits = 4, caption = "Top 30 DE genes by FDR")
```

---

## 5. Heatmap — Top DE Genes

```{r heatmap, fig.height=7}
hm_genes <- rownames(head(de$sig[order(de$sig$FDR), ], p$hm_n_genes))
if (length(hm_genes) > 1) {
  hm <- plot_heatmap(log2cpm, hm_genes, meta,
                     ann_cols     = p$hm_ann_cols,
                     cluster_rows = TRUE,
                     cluster_cols = FALSE,
                     scale        = "row")
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(hm$gtable)
} else {
  cat("Fewer than 2 significant genes — heatmap skipped.")
}
```

---

```{r boxplots-section, results='asis', eval=length(p$genes_of_interest) > 0}
cat("## 6. Boxplots — Genes of Interest\n\n")
```

```{r boxplots, fig.height=5, eval=length(p$genes_of_interest) > 0}
facet_by <- if (!is.null(p$bp_facet_by) && nchar(p$bp_facet_by) > 0) p$bp_facet_by else NULL
plot_boxplots(log2cpm, meta,
              genes    = p$genes_of_interest,
              x_by     = p$bp_x_by,
              color_by = p$bp_color_by,
              facet_by = facet_by)
```

---

```{r gsea-section, results='asis', eval=p$run_gsea && !is.null(p$gmt_file)}
cat("## 7. GSEA\n\n")
```

```{r gsea, eval=p$run_gsea && !is.null(p$gmt_file)}
# Convert if needed
de_for_path <- de
log2cpm_for_path <- log2cpm

if (p$species == "mouse2human") {
  conv <- convert_mouse_human(rownames(log2cpm_for_path))
  if (!is.null(conv) && length(conv) > 0) {
    log2cpm_for_path <- apply_human_symbols(log2cpm_for_path, conv)
    common <- intersect(rownames(de_for_path$all), names(conv))
    de_for_path$all <- de_for_path$all[common, ]
    rownames(de_for_path$all) <- conv[common]
  }
}

gsea_res <- run_gsea(de_for_path$all, p$gmt_file, pval = p$gsea_pval)
if (!is.null(gsea_res$plot)) print(gsea_res$plot)
knitr::kable(head(gsea_res$results[, c("pathway","NES","padj","dir")], 30),
             digits = 4, caption = "Top GSEA pathways")
```

---

```{r ora-section, results='asis', eval=p$run_ora}
cat("## 8. ORA (Over-Representation Analysis)\n\n")
```

```{r ora, eval=p$run_ora}
ora_res <- run_ora(de, species = p$ora_species, ont = p$ora_ont, pval = 0.05)

for (nm in names(ora_res)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", nm))
  df <- as.data.frame(ora_res[[nm]])
  if (nrow(df) > 0) {
    if (requireNamespace("enrichplot", quietly = TRUE))
      print(enrichplot::dotplot(ora_res[[nm]], showCategory = 15,
                                 title = nm))
    print(knitr::kable(head(df[, c("Description","GeneRatio","p.adjust","geneID")], 20),
                       digits = 4))
  } else {
    cat("No significant terms.\n\n")
  }
}
```
